SELECT u.user_id, u.username,
-- ✅ 总计时（用 duration 本身，不跨天） IFNULL(SUM(tr.duration) / 60, 0) AS total_minutes,
-- ✅ 今年（1月1日 ~ 明年1月1日） IFNULL(SUM( CASE WHEN tr.start_time IS NOT NULL AND tr.end_time IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST( TIMESTAMPDIFF( SECOND, GREATEST(tr.start_time, DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-01-01')), LEAST(tr.end_time, DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), '%Y-01-01')) ), 0 ) ELSE 0 END ) / 60, 0) AS year_minutes,
-- ✅ 本月（本月1日 ~ 下月1日） IFNULL(SUM( CASE WHEN tr.start_time IS NOT NULL AND tr.end_time IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST( TIMESTAMPDIFF( SECOND, GREATEST(tr.start_time, DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01')), LEAST(tr.end_time, DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01')) ), 0 ) ELSE 0 END ) / 60, 0) AS month_minutes,
-- ✅ 本周（本周一 ~ 下周一） IFNULL(SUM( CASE WHEN tr.start_time IS NOT NULL AND tr.end_time IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST( TIMESTAMPDIFF( SECOND, GREATEST(tr.start_time, DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY)), LEAST(tr.end_time, DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL 7 DAY)) ), 0 ) ELSE 0 END ) / 60, 0) AS week_minutes,
-- ✅ 今日（今天0点 ~ 明天0点） IFNULL(SUM( CASE WHEN tr.start_time IS NOT NULL AND tr.end_time IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST( TIMESTAMPDIFF( SECOND, GREATEST(tr.start_time, CURDATE()), LEAST(tr.end_time, DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)) ), 0 ) ELSE 0 END ) / 60, 0) AS today_minutes
FROM users u LEFT JOIN time_records tr ON u.user_id = tr.user_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY u.user_id, u.username;

SELECT a.name AS activity_name, SUM( GREATEST( LEAST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(t.end_time), UNIX_TIMESTAMP(#{date} + INTERVAL 1 DAY)) - GREATEST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(t.start_time), UNIX_TIMESTAMP(#{date})), 0 ) ) AS total_duration_today FROM time_records t JOIN activities a ON t.activity_id = a.activity_id WHERE t.start_time < #{date} + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND t.end_time > #{date} GROUP BY a.activity_id;
